title: Propagation dynamics of an acid-mediated invasion model with degenerate tumor diffusion
summary: We investigate traveling wave fronts for an acid-mediated tumor invasion model with density-dependent degenerate diffusion. The model is a partially diffusive PDE--ODE system of Gatenby--Gawlinski type, in which the tumor diffusion coefficient $D(U)$ is allowed to be a general decreasing function satisfying $D(1)=0$. This degeneracy causes the traveling wave equation for the tumor component to lose uniform ellipticity near the healthy state, and hence standard arguments for nondegenerate reaction diffusion systems are not directly applicable.
